name: 33040 · Key West, FL
findings: ZIP 33040 (Key West) has 183 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33040 (Key West) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33040 (Key West) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
